build_TridentConv: build a TridentConv module with shared weights and multiple dilation branches for multi-scale feature extraction
build_TridentBottleneck: build a TridentBottleneck block using TridentConv for multi-branch residual learning in ResNet stage 3
build_TridentResNet: build a TridentResNet backbone that replaces stage 3 Bottleneck blocks with TridentBottleneck for multi-scale output
build_make_trident_res_layer: build a trident residual layer with configurable dilation branches and optional gradient checkpointing support
review_TridentConv_forward: review the TridentConv forward pass that applies different dilations per branch during training or single branch at inference
